venues.name: The Chopping Block (Lincoln Square)
venues.area: Lincoln Square (North Side), not West Loop
venues.usedFor: Recreational cooking school running public hands-on and demo classes plus private cooking parties, corporate team building and client entertaining.
venues.capacity: Private events for 6 to 50 guests. Thyme Kitchen: hands-on parties up to 30; Eggplant Kitchen up to 20; both floors up to 50; all three spaces 50-65 depending on event type (venue website).
venues.price: $1,700 minimum, based on menu and beverage choices; food and drink minimums vary by group size, day and time. Events last 2.5 hours incl. 1.5 hours hands-on cooking plus multi-course meal; beverage packages extra.

rating.note: Yelp listing shows 4.3 stars / 242 reviews per a search-index snapshot titled 'Updated June 2026'; Yelp page itself returned 403 and was not opened.

reviews.author: tom t.
reviews.quote: good class, good, teacher/chef. Would like to have discussed more about the different flavors and spices interacting with each other and taste profiles

reviews.author: Michael S.
reviews.quote: Excellent space. Great instruction by Chef David and his outstanding assistant Alexi.

reviews.author: Anonymous
reviews.quote: Hands-on is always better, and that is what I received.

reviews.author: Linda S.
reviews.quote: Organized extremely well. Good student to chef ratio. Only reason I didn’t give it a 5 is felt rushed to eat what we made.

reviews.author: Tiffani B.
reviews.quote: the class started later and it seemed like the instructor was rushing the process due to that.

venues.name: Tortello (DeSora private event space)
venues.type: Restaurant with private upstairs event space and dedicated kitchen
venues.usedFor: Fresh-pasta shop and counter-service Italian restaurant whose upstairs space, DeSora, hosts hands-on pasta classes and family-style seated dinners for team-building, celebrations and client entertaining.
venues.capacity: DeSora suits groups of 10-48 people (private events page); hands-on pasta-making classes for up to 40 people upstairs in DeSora (pasta classes page).
venues.priceNote: Event packages are in a PDF linked from the private events page that redirects to a filesusr.com host this session could not reach. The only published prices found are for the small pasta-window class (4-6 people; Tock: $600 buyout for 4), not DeSora.

rating.note: From a search-index snapshot of the Yelp page titled 'Updated November 2026 - 628 Reviews'; Yelp page itself was not opened (403). Treat as unverified.

reviews.author: Paul S.
reviews.quote: Perfect spot for our board dinner. Private space with just the right level of attentive service.

venues.name: Chicago Chefs' Table
venues.type: Loft event space with professional kitchen (private dining / culinary event venue)
venues.area: Near North Side (per Tagvenue); on W Division St near Goose Island
venues.usedFor: Rentable private event venue for chef-led dinners, demonstrations, corporate gatherings and showers; can also be rented to host and cook your own event without staff.
venues.capacity: Skyline Loft: dining up to 60, 70 seats / 100 standing; '10 guests interacting with the chef at the kitchen counter'. Grand Oak Room: 120 seats / 200 standing (Tagvenue). Hands-on capacity not stated.
venues.price: Skyline Loft from $550 minimum spend per session (also listed as $550 + $100 hire fee + per person); Grand Oak Room from $3,500 minimum spend. No alcohol provided; BYO with corkage fee.

rating.note: Peerspace shows 5.0 / 6 reviews per search-index snippet (not opened). No Google rating found.
